answer: Each mirror, the identity an attacker spawns, lands on the haven, a public tree filing agents that share keys, funds or near-duplicate output under one branch. A mirror acts only after burning one fable, a slashable attestation, from each of 5 other branches, and a branch may spend just one fable ever into any given branch. An honest agent needs 5 unrelated attesters; 1,000 mirrors on one branch need 5,000 distinct branches, each a judged cluster to build or bribe. It breaks if the haven files bribed branches as unrelated.
